content.comment_body: Hello [user_name], Is it possible for a [product_name] device and a PC to communicate if they're on different subnets? If not, what would be the workaround? I want to display values on a centralized SCADA system located on another subnet.
The [product_name] device and the PC need to be on the same subnet to communicate. If they are on different subnets, you will need to use a router.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking to enable communication between a [product_name] device and a PC that are on separate network subnets. The main technical issue involves network configuration, as direct communication is only allowed within the same subnet, which can affect remote monitoring or centralized control solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that it should be possible for a [product_name] device to communicate with a PC across different subnets or that there is a simple solution to support centralized SCADA visualization in such a setup.
